regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, and ESI availability footnote
regions.finding: The source title and aggregate Pd-catalyzed Suzuki method claim were verified from the original page image. The paper mentions ESI availability, but workspace SI association remains unestablished and no SI facts were imported.
The generic allenyl-anion/electrophile route is cited previous work (references 12a–d), classified as a literature example rather than a current experiment.

The source-drawn phosphine-catalyzed cyclopropenonyl-acetate ring opening is cited previous work. Its printed 20 mol% PR3, 10 equiv MeOH, 4 Å MS, THF, room temperature, and 3 d conditions were retained as a literature example.
The Pd/H+/ligand, alcohol, and CO carboxylation route is labeled the authors' previous work and is not represented as a current-paper experiment.
The carbonate-plus-ArB(OH)2 Suzuki arrow is the generic current reaction class; row-specific experiments are in Tables 1–3 and equations 1–2.

unresolved: Scheme 1 contains generic R/E/Ar/L labels and does not define unique structures or yields.
SI association is unestablished despite the article's ESI availability statement.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 1 ligand screening and footnote
regions.finding: Six ligand conditions were inventoried. Five are separate optimization records; the P(o-tol)3 row is merged with identical Table 2 entry 5. NMR yields, recoveries, not-observed result, slash markers, shared charges, N2, 25 °C, and 1.5 h were retained.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 2 entries 1–10 and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Ten independent catalyst/solvent/loading/water conditions were retained. Footnotes b/c override catalyst loading, d overrides catalyst/ligand loading and time, and e explicitly omits water. Yield and starting-material recovery remain distinct NMR outcomes; dashes are source markers.

The narrative maps functional-group and substrate identities to the sixteen Table 3 rows on page 3. No prose-only duplicates were created; the explicit statement that no alkyne products were observed is retained as a row-level selectivity observation.
Two separately performed 6.0 mmol runs were retained: 1a to 3aa (3 h, 1.2187 g, 88%) and 1b to 3ba (15 h, 1.0590 g, 77%). They are not merged with the 1.0 mmol scope rows.
The text begins four distinct transformations of 3aa/3ba that are fully drawn on page 3; cross-page evidence is used rather than duplicate narrative records.

unresolved: Table 3 yield basis is not explicitly stated on pages 1–5.
Most scope and derivatization rows omit workup, purification, and isolated mass.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 3 header, sixteen structures, yields/times, and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: Sixteen independent scope rows were retained with substrate/boronic-acid labels, 1.0 mmol substrate scale, row time, yield, Ar atmosphere, 25 °C, 2 mL THF, standard or footnote-overridden catalyst/ligand loadings, and the no-alkyne observation.

Four independent derivatizations were retained: CuBr2 bromolactonization to 4 (76%), Et2Zn tandem Michael addition/cyclization to 5 (76%), DIBAL-H reduction to allenol 6 (51%), and LiOH·H2O hydrolysis to acid 7 (70%), with printed equivalents, solvents, temperature, time, and Ar where shown.
The Pd cycle with intermediates I and II is explicitly a proposed mechanism and is classified separately; no intermediate was turned into an isolated experiment.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Table 4 and cytotoxicity prose
regions.finding: Table 4 is a biological A549-cell assay, not a chemical reaction table. It introduces no reaction arrow, reagent charge, chemical conversion, or synthesis yield, so no chemical-reaction record was fabricated.

unresolved: Table 3 yields are printed without an explicit isolated/NMR basis.
Scheme 2 omits scale, solvent volume, workup, purification, product mass, and yield basis.
Biological assay values are outside the chemical-reaction record schema and were classified rather than forced into reaction outcomes.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left continuation of Table 4 interpretation
regions.finding: Cytotoxicity interpretation only; no new chemical transformation or synthetic outcome is reported.

regions.region: page 4 left column Table 5 and GLP-1 discussion
regions.finding: Table 5 is a cell-based GLP-1 secretion assay, not a chemical reaction table. Relative activity and EC50 values were not recast as chemical yields or conversions.
The conclusions summarize the existing Suzuki scope and derivatizations and add no independent experiment.

Zheng Yang is thanked for reproducing results for 3ag, 3cm, and 3bd. Because no independent charges, conditions, yields, or run identifiers are given, this provenance is linked to those existing Table 3 records and creates no duplicate runs.
Bibliographic prior work only; external papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: The reproduction acknowledgment does not identify separable runs.
Biological assay results are not represented as reaction records.
